verdict.rationale: The vendor claims layout-aware accuracy that generic OCR and PDF-to-text tools can't match, and a community report confirms benchmarks with re-runnable code were published. That report also concretely contradicts them: re-running the baseline gave a faithfulness score of 0.980 versus the reported 0.667, beating the LlamaParse result, and the two sides used different retrieval pipelines. A free monthly credit tier lets you run your own evals before committing. Missing for 10: first-party documented, reproducible benchmark methodology and datasets, an apples-to-apples comparison, and an official eval tooling or harness.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, the vendor publishes reproducible accuracy benchmarks and I can run my own evals before committing
